# D Rupesh Kumar

> Senior Vice President of Engineering at Motilal Oswal Financial Services, building agentic AI and fintech platforms. Previously SeekOut, Skyserve.ai and LocationIQ; founder of CLAY (2017-2019). This site also hosts free learning pathways, an index of engineering blogs and explained research papers.

## Learning (free, no sign-in)
- [Learning pathways](https://crysthope.com/learning/): four courses from zero to professional - Foundations, Distributed Systems, System Design, AI Engineering.
- [Research papers, explained](https://crysthope.com/research-papers/): 20 landmark papers (MapReduce, Dynamo, Raft, Spanner and more) with plain-language explainers.
- [Industry tech blogs](https://crysthope.com/tech-blogs/): one reader over 90+ engineering blogs, engineering write-ups only, refreshed every six hours; every card links to the original.
